milan: kicked off a 2% canary for rwd-v8-quant4-shadow. headline: p50 down ~21%, cost down ~36%, but we see signal elevation: drift_score +0.05 (ewma 1h), code-snipe MRR -2.3% abs, prefix-match fidelity on longdocs -2.0%. putting up slice CSV and proposing a sentinel-style gate rather than pure delta thresholds. thoughts? :satellite:
zara: paste the CSV so we can eyeball volumes and which intents are hot. :mag:
otto: quick extract from the run:
```
slice,queries,mrr,baseline_mrr,delta_abs,drift_score,kl_norm,halluc_pp
chat-short,9800,0.786,0.783,+0.3,0.007,0.002,0.009
code-snipe,2100,0.612,0.635,-2.3,0.048,0.019,0.017
longdoc-prefix,1200,0.495,0.515,-2.0,0.053,0.024,0.011
kb-retrieval,3000,0.739,0.742,-0.3,0.011,0.004,0.005
```
becks: first-pass take: regressions concentrated on code-snipe and longdoc-prefix. drift_score (our EWMA on normalized per-token KL + truncation) is the unique bit here and is elevated for those slices. I propose a 3-tier "sentinel" gate (quiet-dump -> partial-steer -> hard-rollback) with both per-slice weights and a global aggregate sentinel_score. Sketch:
- sentinel_score = weighted_sum(slice_weight * (zscore_mrr + drift_norm + kl_norm))/sum(weights) (use short baseline window 30d)
- Tier 1 (quiet-dump): trigger if any high-priority slice has drift_score > 0.04 AND weighted_mrr_drop >= 1.0% over 20m -> action: throttle variant to 10% for 30m, increase sampling x8 on affected slices, take stealth-shadow snapshots.
- Tier 2 (partial-steer): trigger if sentinel_score > 0.06 OR halluc_delta_pp > 0.6pp sustained 25m -> action: steer 50% traffic to fallback (prefer local int8 pool), spawn full-shadow for 6h, notify oncall.
- Tier 3 (hard-rollback): trigger if sentinel_score > 0.1 OR weighted_mrr_drop >= 2.5% over 45m OR kl_norm > 0.03 sustained 20m -> immediate rollback to pinned variant and page SRE.

zara: love the sentinel framing. couple notes: 1) make per-slice min-queries = 600 per 30m to avoid noisy small slices 2) coldstart smoothing: ignore first 15% traffic per slice for first 10m 3) add a cooldown 45m after any Tier 1 action to avoid oscillation.
becks: agree. also recommend per-slice override knobs: code-snipe weight=2.5, longdoc-prefix weight=1.9, and lower Tier1 threshold for code-snipe (drift_score > 0.035) because downstream cost is high.
otto: ops question: for Dedicated customers, what's our preferred behavior? auto-steer or require ops approval?
milan: mapping: Hosted -> Tier1 auto (quiet-dump) ; Tier2 auto-steer if fallback pool exists otherwise ops-approval ; Tier3 always auto-rollback. Dedicated -> Tier1 requires ops-ack to steer, Tier2 ops-notify + prepare local int8 standby, Tier3 auto-rollback but prefer local int8 route if available. We'll document this in the rollout playbook.
sre-bot: smoke checks for rwd-v8-quant4-shadow: unit-tests ✅, canary-load ✅, sentinel-eval WARN (slices: code-snipe, longdoc-prefix)
milan: action items: 1) otto run an expanded shadow for code-snipe x8 and include halluc sample diffs (due tomorrow morning) 2) becks encode sentinel_score into gate-engine with per-slice weights + coldstart ignore + cooldown 3) zara update playbook with Dedicated mapping and operator flows 4) otto schedule sample-run id 1759050000 for focused shadowing. tagging @becks for implementation signoff before we enable any auto-tier actions. :white_check_mark:
becks: will start the gate-engine PR and include test harness for sentinel_score. will default Tier1 to quarantine (throttle) not rollback.
milan: thanks team. will hold Tier2/3 auto-promote until we see shadow results. :thumbsup:
